Name: Oracle Cloud SaaS Security Baseline
Description: Security Baseline controls for Oracle Cloud Applications (Oracle Fusion ERP, HCM, SCM, and IDCS Identity Domains).

Requirements.Name: Enforce MFA for Privileged and Finance Identities
Requirements.Description: Configure sign-on policies in Oracle Identity Cloud Service (IDCS) requiring MFA for administrative and finance user accounts.

Requirements.Name: Decommission Implementation Roles Post-Go-Live
Requirements.Description: Revoke the Application Implementation Consultant role from production users immediately following go-live.

Requirements.Name: Eliminate Separation of Duties (SoD) Conflicts
Requirements.Description: Ensure no user possesses conflicting roles across payables, receivables, general ledger, and procurement.

Requirements.Name: Password Policy Hardening & Session Timeout
Requirements.Description: Enforce 12+ character password policy complexity, lockout rules, and 15-minute idle session timeouts in IDCS.

Requirements.Name: PII Masking & BIP Export Restrictions
Requirements.Description: Mask sensitive employee PII and restrict unencrypted BI Publisher report exports.

Requirements.Name: Enable Oracle Fusion ERP Audit Trail & Retention
Requirements.Description: Audit policies must be active for all sensitive business objects with 365-day retention.

Requirements.Name: IDCS Network Perimeters and API Scope Hardening
Requirements.Description: Configure IP allowlisting on IDCS sign-on policies and limit OAuth application scopes to least privilege.
